scenes.say: Ever wonder who actually runs your containers in Kubernetes? Let's break down who's really in charge.
The control plane makes all the decisions. Worker nodes do the actual work, running your containers and handling traffic.

scenes.label: Declarative
scenes.sub: You say what you want; controllers make it true.
scenes.say: Here's the magic: you declare what you want, and controllers keep working until that's reality.

scenes.title: Control Plane in Action
scenes.say: Try these commands to see your nodes and the system pods running behind the scenes.

scenes.question: What does the worker node do?
scenes.right: It runs containers and handles traffic.
scenes.say: Here's a classic interview trap: worker nodes don't make decisions—they just run the containers and handle networking.
